name: VNX British Pound
oneLiner: VGBP is VNX's Liechtenstein-licensed pound sterling stablecoin redeemable 1:1, backed by GBP cash in Swiss and Liechtenstein bank accounts.
collateral: GBP deposits held in bank accounts in Switzerland and Liechtenstein, confirmed 1:1 by Areva General Auditing and Trust Company Limited (December 2024)
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through VNX Commodities AG; tokens minted on demand for verified customers depositing equivalent GBP value

FMA Liechtenstein - MiCAR e-money token requirements (EMT issuance reserved to credit/e-money institutions)

proofOfReserves.provider: AREVA General Auditing and Trust Company Limited

mintAuthority.summary: VGBP is issued by VNX Commodities AG, a Liechtenstein FMA-licensed entity; tokens are minted on demand for verified customers depositing GBP and the token's on-chain admin is an issuer-controlled upgradeable-proxy owner.

controls.label: VNX upgradeable-proxy admin/owner (Base)
controls.evidence: BaseScan shows the VGBP token at this address is an EIP-1967 TransparentUpgradeableProxy using OwnableUpgradeable + PausableUpgradeable with RBAC; proxy admin 0x1724768a253476159a622a1689146862d3b762c2 holds upgrade authority and the owner/deployer is 0xd63052e09af164cef57695d3b96043ea848b051f, both issuer-controlled.

review.evidence: VNX docs and the Liechtenstein FMA TVTG license describe VGBP as a 1:1 GBP-redeemable token minted by VNX Commodities AG against bank-held GBP reserves; on-chain the Base contract is an upgradeable proxy with issuer-held Ownable/admin roles, so mint creation is centrally controlled by the issuer.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm which exact role/address holds the live mint privilege in the implementation bytecode and whether the proxy admin is an EOA, multisig, or Safe.
